title: Even though we are living in an age where growing old is tho…

sents.en: Even though we are living in an age where growing old is thought of as an inevitable misery, this doctor has been changing the game for seniors over the last 25 years.
sents.cn: 尽管我们生活在一个把变老视为必然苦难的时代，这位医生在过去25年里一直在改变老年人的生活境况

sents.en: It all started in 1991 when the Harvard-educated physician was transferred from working in a stressful emergency room to being the medical director of a nursing home in upstate New York.
sents.cn: 一切始于1991年。这位毕业于哈佛的医生从压力巨大的急诊室，调任纽约州北部一家养老院的医疗主任。

sents.en: The depressing and regimented (严格管制的) environment got him thinking on what exactly could improve the residents' conditions.
sents.cn: 压抑而刻板的环境促使他思考：究竟怎样才能改善住养老院的老人们的生活状况。

sents.en: Even though animals in nursing homes were illegal at the time, Dr. Bill Thomas took a chance.
sents.cn: 尽管当时养老院养动物并不合法，比尔∙托马斯医生还是冒险一试。

sents.en: Based on a hunch (直觉), he brought in two dogs, four cats, hens, rabbits, 100 birds, a multitude of plants, a flower garden, and a vegetable patch.
sents.cn: 凭着一股直觉，他带来了两只狗、四只猫、母鸡、兔子、100只鸟，还有许多植物、一座花园和一块菜地。

sents.en: The change was dramatic. There was a 50% drop in medical prescriptions along with a dramatic decrease in death rates·but most importantly, the residents were simply happier.
sents.cn: 变化是惊人的：处方用药量下降了50%，死亡率也大幅降低——而最重要的是，老人们明显更快乐了。

sents.en: Dr. Thomas's approach, named the Eden Alternative, has driven nursing homes to allow a more autonomous (自主的) and creative living space for their elderly.
sents.cn: 托马斯医生的方法被称为"伊甸选择"，它推动养老院为老人提供更自主、更有创造性的生活空间。

sents.en: It erases the belief that growing old means growing useless.
sents.cn: 它颠覆了"变老即无用"的观念。

sents.en: He encourages residents to think of their age as an enriching new phase of life rather than the end of it.
sents.cn: 他鼓励老人把年岁渐长看作人生一个更加丰富的新阶段，而非生命的尽头。

sents.en: Thomas, now a speaker and author of several books, also created small, independently-run residences with their own bedrooms and bathrooms, and he has been preaching a singular message that getting old is not a bad thing.
sents.cn: 如今的托马斯既做演讲，也写了好几本书。他还创办了配备独立卧室和卫生间的小型自主经营式住所，并且一直在传播一个理念：变老并不是坏事。

sents.en: "Within six weeks, they had to send a truck around to pick up all the wheelchairs," Thomas told the Washington Post.
sents.cn: "不到六个星期，他们就不得不派卡车来收走所有的轮椅，"托马斯对《华盛顿邮报》说。

sents.en: "You know why most people in nursing homes use wheelchairs?
sents.cn: "你知道为什么养老院里大多数人都坐轮椅吗？

sents.en: Because the buildings are so big."
The 56-year-old doctor's methods have been adopted in Australia, Japan, Canada, and America with enormous success.
sents.cn: 这位56岁医生的方法已在澳大利亚、日本、加拿大和美国落地，成效显著。

sents.en: Last year he published Second Wind: Navigating the Passage to a Slower, Deeper, and More Connected Life, a guide on how to shift our perspectives on aging and growth.
sents.cn: 去年，他出版了《第二口风：驶向更从容、更深刻、更紧密相连的人生》一书，指导我们如何转变对衰老与成长的看法。

sents.en: He is currently traveling through North America performing with his guitar and his enthusiasm on his Age of Disruption Tour.
sents.cn: 目前，他正带着吉他与热情在北美巡回演出，开展他的"打破陈规之旅"。
